text:
mica: quick ux check — noticed tooltip spam when you hover over the compact sparklines on the Routes overview. dozens of tiny annotation callouts appear and block the chart :grimacing:
oliver: which page / which sparkline size? i can't repro on my monitor
mica: the 3-up compact mode (24px height). repro on Chrome + VoiceOver when moving mouse quickly. reported by a customer during a demo
tara: ah — are these the little yellow 'outlier' pins + per-point timestamps?
mica: yep. each marker opens its own tooltip. it feels noisy and is terrible for keyboard/voiceover focus
jonah: can we collapse them into one aggregated tooltip on hover that lists the nearby events? e.g. show primary value + a small list: "3 outliers · last: 2024-11-02 12:34" and a link "Open details"
oliver: agree. also copy tweak: replace ambiguous "outliers" with "spikes" in compact mode? customer called them spikes during the call
tara: for a11y: voiceover should announce a single region when focus lands on the sparkline. suggestion: add role="button" + aria-expanded to toggle details. example copy for screen readers: "Sparkline: latest 350ms, spikes: 3, press enter for details"
jonah: implementation note: keep hover for mouse as aggregated, but keyboard focus should move to the same aggregated element to avoid multiple stops
mica: sample CSS/js we tried locally:
```
.sparkline-marker { pointer-events: none; }
.sparkline-aggregate { pointer-events: auto; }
```
but pointer-events none prevented focus for some screen readers so needs careful testing
oliver: maybe better to render markers visually but keep them aria-hidden and surface one accessible control. then the aggregate control reads out counts and exposes a keyboard menu
tara: copy nit from product: change "View details" -> "Open timeline" in that aggregated tooltip. shorter, more action-y
jonah: we'll also need to adjust analytics events (hover_tooltip_compact -> hover_tooltip_compact_aggregated) so we don't lose telemetry on interactions
mica: design-bot: uploaded an updated sketch (link) and a 2-state prototype (collapsed / expanded). Can we ask QA to run voiceover + NVDA on collapsed mode? :eyes:
design-bot: uploaded sketch: https://figma.redwood/proto/ux-1719012345
oliver: i'll prototype the aria-hidden approach and post a short demo. ping me if you want to test with a specific screen reader
tara: small follow-up: unit label in the tooltip should read "P95 latency" not "95th" — that's clearer for non-metric folks
michael: +1 on P95 wording (michael from PM via DM but he asked to be cc'd)
jonah: plan: oliver builds prototype -> design + tara test a11y -> adjust copy -> ship as small patch to production flags. estimated effort: 1-2 dev days
mica: perfect. thanks all :thumbsup:
